$comment: Architectural layers (ADR 0047) and which directory belongs to each. Checked by scripts/check-boundaries.mjs in CI. A unit may depend on its own layer and on the layers listed in its layer's `allow`; anything else is a violation. Every npm workspace, Go module and Dockerfile directory must match exactly one unit, so a new component cannot land unclassified.

framework.description: Wire protocols, agent/tool SDKs and shared libraries. Usable with no cluster; depends on nothing else in this repo.

catalog.description: Reference tools and agents. Built on the framework, deployed by the orchestrator, owned by neither.

orchestrator.description: Engines, controller, brokers, gateways, sidecars and charts that run agents at scale.

test.description: Cross-cutting end-to-end suites; may exercise every layer.
